description: Sweep all active OpenSpec proposals for staleness, conflicts, and obsolescence against the current codebase and archived changes. Use when proposals may be outdated, when checking cross-proposal conflicts, or before starting a batch of implementations. Produces a gap-analysis report, updates a priority queue file, and can auto-fix trivial issues or guide conversations for complex ones.
